standard_prerequisites.name: Lifting of specializations along a flat morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-generalizations-lift-flat, invoked at proof line 5137
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the specialization in the base be lifted to a specialization in the source ending at the generic point of the special fibre, which rules out an impurity.

core_obligations: Rule out impurities: for a specialization in the base and a point of the source over its endpoint, if that point is associated to its fibre then it is the unique generic point of that fibre because the fibre is integral, and flatness lifts the specialization to one ending at the generic point of the special fibre (proof lines 5130-5138).
Conclude that the point specializes into the special fibre, so the data do not form an impurity (proof lines 5138-5140).
Use base change invariance: since the hypotheses are preserved under base change, there is no impurity after any base change either, which is universal purity (proof lines 5140-5144).
proof_roadmap: Integrality of the fibres and lifting of specializations (proof lines 5130-5138).
The point specializes into the special fibre (proof lines 5138-5140).
Base change invariance gives universal purity (proof lines 5140-5144).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a finite type flat morphism with geometrically integral fibres is universally pure (statement lines 5123-5128, tag 05MC-adjacent). The proof takes a specialization in the base and a point of the source over its endpoint, uses integrality of the fibres to identify that point as the generic point of its fibre, and lifts the specialization along the flat morphism to end at the generic point of the special fibre, so that no impurity arises; since the hypotheses are preserved by base change, universal purity follows. The lifting step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
